t: A ready-made 1 watt Meshtastic radio kit for long-range off-grid text messages.
steps: Buy the kit from the RAKwireless store for about 39 US dollars, or from Rokland in the US for about 50 dollars.
Pick the 915 MHz version for the US or the 868 MHz version for Europe.
Attach the LoRa antenna and the Bluetooth antenna from the box.
Set the power jumper for battery mode and connect a 3.7 V Li-ion cell, or use EX_5V with a regulated 5 V 1.5 A supply.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone.
Pair the radio over Bluetooth and set your region in the app.
Send a first message to a friend's Meshtastic radio.
Check your local power rules before running at the full 1 watt.
meta: Open Board. From $39. A few stores.
